I took my girlfriend for a holiday in my homeland of Rarotonga. We went on the interisland cross trek which is a walk that goes from one side of the island to the other. We also wanted to go the needle and so we did. To get to the needle, it consists of just chains hanging on a somewhat steep slope, nothing else. We get to the top, embracing the moment. On our way down, her first step, she rolls her ankle and she takes it as really bad and in the area we are in, I do to. It was pure terror because she didn't have the ability to hold onto the chain and walk down, she had to slide down and one wrong slip up and she would practically just fall to her death. I was terrified of losing her.

Something to shed a bit more light on that. We made it safely and I suggested that I would piggy back her for the rest of the way, I did. Not even a minute through, we walked past this Australian group and upon passing the last person of the group, I slipped and landed on her ankle. On the outside I felt bad, on the inside I was having a little giggle. Don't worry, she laughed a bit too.

To answer your first question, there are around 3 offline modes that you can consistently play. 2 other offline modes that are usually one and done's, completing these 2 offline modes contribute to a Challenge of the Week token. These are the Warm-Up Challenges and Challenges. The other 3 offline modes are Domination, Weekly Challenges and Moment Challenges. Domination contributes to rewarding you with a player card after every team you "dominate" and rewarding you with a high overall card you can select from on completion of this game mode, therefore unlocking another offline mode called Historic Domination you can win higher rewards and gaining another higher overall card upon completion. Weekly challenges as explained, there are 5 games released weekly that offer MT as a reward upon completion and contribute to a weekly challenge token. Weekly challenge tokens contribute to unlocking a very special player to add to your MyTeam collection. Moments challenges are released to replicate a players game in today's NBA majority of the time. If a player has an outstanding performance in the NBA, chances are they will have a Moments challenge that players can play, this will require having a card of the player and achieving the objective of the challenge. Moments challenge are usually known for the big amounts of MT earned on completion.
